description: This dashboard summarizes fleet health, reliability, and performance in one operational view. It helps stakeholders quickly understand current state and prioritize next actions.

panels.description: This metric shows total active proxies for the selected scope and period. Use it as a quick checkpoint before deeper drill-down.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) as value FROM proxies p WHERE p.active = true
  AND (CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(p.name)) REGEXP 'S[0-9]{1,3}[[:space:]_-]*P[0-9]+' THEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(TRIM(p.name)), 'S[0-9]{1,3}[[:space:]_-]*P[0-9]+'), 'S[0-9]{1,3}') WHEN UPPER(TRIM(p.name)) REGEXP '^S[0-9]{1,3}[[:space:]_-]+[0-9]+' THEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(TRIM(p.name)), '^S[0-9]{1,3}') ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END) IN ($server)
  AND p.device_id IN ($phone)

panels.title: Total Active Proxies

panels.description: This metric shows total request activity in the selected period, including successful and failed attempts. It provides baseline demand context for interpreting quality and performance changes.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT SUM(s.total_requests) as value
FROM proxy_requests_daily_summary s
JOIN proxies p ON s.proxy_id = p.device_id
WHERE s.day >= DATE($__timeFrom()) AND s.day <= DATE($__timeTo())
  AND (CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(p.name)) REGEXP 'S[0-9]{1,3}[[:space:]_-]*P[0-9]+' THEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(TRIM(p.name)), 'S[0-9]{1,3}[[:space:]_-]*P[0-9]+'), 'S[0-9]{1,3}') WHEN UPPER(TRIM(p.name)) REGEXP '^S[0-9]{1,3}[[:space:]_-]+[0-9]+' THEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(TRIM(p.name)), '^S[0-9]{1,3}') ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END) IN ($server)
  AND p.device_id IN ($phone)

panels.description: This metric shows the percentage of requests that completed successfully in the selected period. It is the primary reliability KPI and should be read with traffic volume for proper context.

targets.rawSql:

FROM proxy_requests_daily_summary s
JOIN proxies p ON s.proxy_id = p.device_id
WHERE s.day >= DATE($__timeFrom()) AND s.day <= DATE($__timeTo())
  AND (CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(p.name)) REGEXP 'S[0-9]{1,3}[[:space:]_-]*P[0-9]+' THEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(TRIM(p.name)), 'S[0-9]{1,3}[[:space:]_-]*P[0-9]+'), 'S[0-9]{1,3}') WHEN UPPER(TRIM(p.name)) REGEXP '^S[0-9]{1,3}[[:space:]_-]+[0-9]+' THEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(TRIM(p.name)), '^S[0-9]{1,3}') ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END) IN ($server)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT UNIX_TIMESTAMP(s.day) as time_sec, SUM(s.total_requests) as total_requests
FROM proxy_requests_daily_summary s
JOIN proxies p ON s.proxy_id = p.device_id
WHERE s.day >= DATE($__timeFrom()) AND s.day <= DATE($__timeTo())
  AND (CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(p.name)) REGEXP 'S[0-9]{1,3}[[:space:]_-]*P[0-9]+' THEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(TRIM(p.name)), 'S[0-9]{1,3}[[:space:]_-]*P[0-9]+'), 'S[0-9]{1,3}') WHEN UPPER(TRIM(p.name)) REGEXP '^S[0-9]{1,3}[[:space:]_-]+[0-9]+' THEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(TRIM(p.name)), '^S[0-9]{1,3}') ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END) IN ($server)
  AND p.device_id IN ($phone)
GROUP BY s.day
ORDER BY s.day

targets.rawSql:
SELECT UNIX_TIMESTAMP(s.day) as time_sec, ROUND(SUM(s.success_count) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(s.total_requests), 0), 2) as success_rate
FROM proxy_requests_daily_summary s
JOIN proxies p ON s.proxy_id = p.device_id
WHERE s.day >= DATE($__timeFrom()) AND s.day <= DATE($__timeTo())
  AND (CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(p.name)) REGEXP 'S[0-9]{1,3}[[:space:]_-]*P[0-9]+' THEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(TRIM(p.name)), 'S[0-9]{1,3}[[:space:]_-]*P[0-9]+'), 'S[0-9]{1,3}') WHEN UPPER(TRIM(p.name)) REGEXP '^S[0-9]{1,3}[[:space:]_-]+[0-9]+' THEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(TRIM(p.name)), '^S[0-9]{1,3}') ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END) IN ($server)
  AND p.device_id IN ($phone)
GROUP BY s.day
ORDER BY s.day

panels.title: Success Rate % (daily)

panels.description: This metric reflects rotation execution and outcome quality for the selected scope. It helps detect stalled, weak, or failing rotation behavior early.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  UNIX_TIMESTAMP(s.day) as time_sec,
  SUM(s.ip_rotation_periodic_success_count) as periodic_success,
  SUM(s.ip_rotation_periodic_failure_count) as periodic_failure,
  SUM(s.ip_rotation_continuous_success_count) as continuous_success,
  SUM(s.ip_rotation_continuous_failure_count) as continuous_failure
FROM proxy_requests_daily_summary s
JOIN proxies p ON s.proxy_id = p.device_id
WHERE s.day >= DATE($__timeFrom()) AND s.day <= DATE($__timeTo())
  AND (CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(p.name)) REGEXP 'S[0-9]{1,3}[[:space:]_-]*P[0-9]+' THEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(TRIM(p.name)), 'S[0-9]{1,3}[[:space:]_-]*P[0-9]+'), 'S[0-9]{1,3}') WHEN UPPER(TRIM(p.name)) REGEXP '^S[0-9]{1,3}[[:space:]_-]+[0-9]+' THEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(TRIM(p.name)), '^S[0-9]{1,3}') ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END) IN ($server)
  AND p.device_id IN ($phone)
GROUP BY s.day
ORDER BY s.day

panels.title: IP Rotation Outcomes (daily)

panels.description: This metric measures distinct outbound IP coverage in the selected scope and period. Higher values indicate stronger diversity and lower concentration risk.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT UNIX_TIMESTAMP(s.day) as time_sec, SUM(s.unique_ips_count) as unique_ips_count
FROM proxy_requests_daily_summary s
JOIN proxies p ON s.proxy_id = p.device_id
WHERE s.day >= DATE($__timeFrom()) AND s.day <= DATE($__timeTo())
  AND (CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(p.name)) REGEXP 'S[0-9]{1,3}[[:space:]_-]*P[0-9]+' THEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(TRIM(p.name)), 'S[0-9]{1,3}[[:space:]_-]*P[0-9]+'), 'S[0-9]{1,3}') WHEN UPPER(TRIM(p.name)) REGEXP '^S[0-9]{1,3}[[:space:]_-]+[0-9]+' THEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(TRIM(p.name)), '^S[0-9]{1,3}') ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END) IN ($server)
  AND p.device_id IN ($phone)
GROUP BY s.day
ORDER BY s.day

panels.description: Per-phone IP sessions per day: SUM(unique_ips_count) — each phone's distinct IPs per day, summed across all phones. A shared IP is counted once PER PHONE, so this is NOT a fleet-deduplicated unique-IP count. Read it as rotation/usage intensity, not the size of the distinct IP pool.

panels.description: This metric measures request speed, including slow-end latency risk where applicable. Persistent increases signal degrading user experience and should trigger performance triage.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  s.day,
  s.proxy_id,
  COALESCE(s.device_name, p.name, s.proxy_id) as device_name,
  COALESCE(s.server_name, CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(p.name)) REGEXP 'S[0-9]{1,3}[[:space:]_-]*P[0-9]+' THEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(TRIM(p.name)), 'S[0-9]{1,3}[[:space:]_-]*P[0-9]+'), 'S[0-9]{1,3}') WHEN UPPER(TRIM(p.name)) REGEXP '^S[0-9]{1,3}[[:space:]_-]+[0-9]+' THEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(TRIM(p.name)), '^S[0-9]{1,3}') ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END) as server_name,
  s.total_requests,
  s.success_count,
  s.failure_count,
  ROUND(s.success_rate_pct, 1) as success_rate_pct,
  ROUND(s.avg_response_time_ms, 0) as avg_response_ms,
  s.p95_response_time_ms as p95_response_ms,
  s.timeout_count,
  s.ip_change_count,
  s.unique_ips_count,
  s.ip_rotation_periodic_success_count,
  s.ip_rotation_periodic_failure_count,
  s.ip_rotation_inactive_proxy_success_count,
  s.ip_rotation_inactive_proxy_failure_count,
  s.ip_rotation_continuous_success_count,
  s.ip_rotation_continuous_failure_count,
  TRIM(BOTH ',' FROM REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(s.ip_history_json, '$.uniqueIps')), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(s.ip_history_json, '$.assignedIps')), ''), '[', ''), ']', ''), '"', '')) as ip_history
FROM proxy_requests_daily_summary s
JOIN proxies p ON s.proxy_id = p.device_id
WHERE s.day >= DATE($__timeFrom()) AND s.day <= DATE($__timeTo())
  AND (CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(p.name)) REGEXP 'S[0-9]{1,3}[[:space:]_-]*P[0-9]+' THEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(TRIM(p.name)), 'S[0-9]{1,3}[[:space:]_-]*P[0-9]+'), 'S[0-9]{1,3}') WHEN UPPER(TRIM(p.name)) REGEXP '^S[0-9]{1,3}[[:space:]_-]+[0-9]+' THEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(TRIM(p.name)), '^S[0-9]{1,3}') ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END) IN ($server)
  AND p.device_id IN ($phone)
ORDER BY s.day DESC, s.total_requests DESC
